name: Single-Arm Lateral Raise (Cable)
instructions: Stand sideways to a low pulley, holding the handle with the outside hand.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, slight elbow bend.
Don't shrug — initiate with the side delt.
Lower slowly. The cable provides constant tension unlike dumbbells.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: A beginner cable press-pattern exercise targeting the middle delts. Single-Arm Lateral Raise (Cable) builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
